journey.name: onchain accepted result
journey.description: Verifies that fixed-amount and send-all sends show success after the configured backend acknowledges the transaction, and that an accepted send finishes its local activity before a new send is admitted. Precondition: an onboarded E2E wallet on regtest with confirmed Savings funds sufficient for both sends and fees, a synced running node, and a second test wallet's regtest receiving address. The wallet, recipient and backend must be test fixtures. Rejected or missing-result cases need controlled broadcast-refusal/response-loss fixtures, which the Capabilities table does not provide, and belong in Manual Tests.

actions.action: Hand the receiving test wallet address to the app with xcrun simctl openurl <simulator-id> "bitcoin:<test recipient address>?amount=0.00001"
If iOS asks whether to open the payment link in Bitkit, choose Open
Verify the Send Amount screen (id "SendAmount") is visible with 1 000 sats and Savings selected
Tap Continue (id "ContinueAmount") and verify the Confirm screen shows the receiving test wallet address (id "ReviewUri")
Swipe the send handle (id "GRAB") fully to the right
Wait for the sent screen (id "SendSuccess") and verify it shows the accepted payment amount
Tap Details (id "Details"), tap Transaction Details (id "ActivityTxDetails"), and record the exact transaction ID (id "TXID") without selecting a different transaction by address or amount
Navigate back from Transaction Details, then back from the activity to the wallet home screen
Hand the receiving test wallet address to the app again with xcrun simctl openurl <simulator-id> "bitcoin:<test recipient address>"
If iOS asks whether to open the payment link in Bitkit, choose Open
Tap the available balance (id "AvailableAmount") on Send Amount to choose Max, tap Continue (id "ContinueAmount"), and verify the Confirm screen shows the receiving test wallet address
Swipe the send handle (id "GRAB") fully to the right

Wait for the sent screen (id "SendSuccess"), tap Details (id "Details"), tap Transaction Details (id "ActivityTxDetails"), and verify this send-all transaction has its own exact transaction ID (id "TXID")
